id: title:Gilbert09:stop reusing an unreachable redis client in row tracking

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse row tracking and ingestion reliability
review.reason: Adds Redis client reset and corresponding test. P1.F1.H1 resets Redis client to None after a failed ping, preventing uncaught connection errors in warehouse row tracking. P1.F2.H1 tests the setup does not raise when Redis is unreachable. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation and test, but the actual production benefit and the specific warehouse connector behavior are not independently verified; the score relies on the assumption that warehouse row tracking is a critical path, which is not explicitly demonstrated in the provided context.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a production implementation change. P1.F2.H1 is a test. The implementation and test are consistent, supporting a score. No score assigned as requested.
